claim: At an inert send-marker transaction, recheck current issuer-scoped public-key trust as well as the mandatory signed-grant authority; a valid earlier approval is not enough if a dispatch key disappears before send. Snapshot retained evidence before locking and keep the transactional callback bounded and free of attempt-store or network calls. Deployment trust-update ordering remains separately specified.
